    • blockItem

      public @NonNull PaletteLayer.Builder blockItem(@NonNull String block, @NonNull CustomBlock.BlockItem item, @Nullable CreativePlacement creative)
      Registers the item of a custom block separately from the block, e.g. when the block comes from an earlier layer (registered there with CustomBlock.BlockItem.NONE), or to order block items among custom items: runtime and canonical ids are assigned in the order of item(org.geysermc.paletter.item.CustomItem) and blockItem calls.
      Since:
      1.0.0

    • variant

      @Internal public @NonNull PaletteLayer.Builder variant(@NonNull ItemVariant variant)
      Gives an item variant a canonical id, so that Palette.decode(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.ItemData) recognizes it. Needed for variants of the newest version that are neither an item's base variant nor in the creative inventory, e.g. a damage value or block state a consumer maps to. Ids are appended after the custom items of this layer, in call order; variants that already have one keep it. Like every canonical id they are the same in every version.
